title: RelayPlan
description: Codex -> WorkBuddy. The execution plan Codex authored and WorkBuddy must follow.

objective.description: One-sentence restatement of the goal, as Codex understood it.

assumptions.description: What Codex assumed that the task brief did not state. Empty array if none. Use null only if impossible.

steps.description: Execution order. Ids must be contiguous from 1.

id.description: 1-based execution order, contiguous with no gaps.

description.description: What this step accomplishes, in plain language.

command.description: Exact shell command for WorkBuddy to run. No placeholders.

cwd.description: Working directory relative to the plan's --cwd, or null for the default.

expected_effect.description: Observable change that proves the step worked. Must be checkable from captured stdout/stderr.

requires_confirmation.description: true when the step is destructive or hard to reverse; WorkBuddy must ask the user first.

acceptance_criteria.description: Conditions the reviewer can check from captured stdout/stderr and exit codes alone.

risks.description: Known hazards. Empty array if none.
